channel.title: Jaryd's News
channel.description: Daily news digest — stories confirmed by multiple independent outlets, each with a Community Note and, where available, a verified YouTube news clip. Includes Joke of the day and Quote of the day on the homepage. Wire reprints count as one. Sources exclude BBC, CNN, CBC, and Radio-Canada. Viral on social highlights confirmed true videos circulating worldwide, plus select claim checks.

item.title: Carney calls Quebec moment “crucial,” urges economic focus after PQ minority win
item.description: A day after the Parti Québécois won a minority (59 of 127 seats), Prime Minister Mark Carney said Tuesday he spoke with premier-designate Paul St-Pierre Plamondon and urged focus on housing, infrastructure and tariff impacts rather than a referendum years away. Alberta’s Oct. 19 vote is less than two weeks away. Why it matters: Quebec’s first PQ government since 2014 is a minority needing opposition support — national-unity coverage also points at Alberta’s Oct. 19 ballot. What changed: Carney’s Tuesday call and “crucial time” remarks joined overnight seat math (PQ 59; CAQ shutout). Community Note: minority not majority; ~28% popular vote; referendum deferred past Jan 2029 per PQ statements. Video: FRANCE 24 English https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gDMpCNteV_Q

item.title: Edmonton raises electricity franchise fee to 19.4% and maps four-year budget process
item.description: Council voted 8–5 Tuesday to raise Edmonton’s electricity franchise fee to 19.4% of distribution charges, matching Calgary. Draft budgets Nov. 2; public hearing from Nov. 23. Why it matters: Higher franchise fees hit power bills while council tries to hold down property-tax growth. What changed: Tuesday’s vote and published Nov. 2 / Nov. 23 budget calendar.

item.title: Oct. 19 Alberta referendum: special ballots, advance voting, and safeguards
item.description: Albertans vote Oct. 19 on 10 referendum questions. Elections Alberta: 652,000+ special ballots approved; packages due by 5 p.m. Oct. 16; advance voting Oct. 13–17. Why it matters: Practical voting timeline now less than two weeks away. Video: Elections Alberta https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nDbd2yGHG6o

item.title: Smith says she has no knowledge of reported separatist–U.S. strategist meetings
item.description: Premier Danielle Smith’s office said Monday she has no knowledge of reported meetings between Alberta separatists and U.S. strategists, and that she opposes separation or Alberta becoming a U.S. state.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region kills two; Russia claims large intercepts
item.description: A major overnight Ukrainian drone assault on Moscow and nearby regions killed at least two people, Russian officials said. Intercept tallies vary and are not independently verified drone-by-drone.

item.title: Yemen fighting near Bab al-Mandeb; Saudi airports hit; battlefield claims contested
item.description: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claimed gains near Bab al-Mandeb; Houthis denied key claims; AP/Reuters could not independently verify. Saudi Arabia said two airports were attacked.

item.title: Kenya records first Ebola death — imported case from DRC
item.description: Kenya reported its first Ebola-related death after an imported case from the DRC. Contact tracing under way; not described as community spread. Video: FRANCE 24 English https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAMXLpR479Q

item.title: Emera and Canadian Utilities announce $72-billion combination
item.description: Emera, Canadian Utilities, and ATCO announced a ~$72-billion combination, subject to approvals. Alberta’s ATCO is in the deal.

item.title: Canada’s trade surplus widens to $4.2 billion in August; loonie firms
item.description: Statistics Canada: merchandise trade surplus widened to $4.2 billion in August 2026, partly from front-loading ahead of U.S. tariffs. CAD firmed Tuesday.

item.title: Six Nations Haldimand Tract trial opens in Toronto
item.description: Civil trial over Six Nations’ Haldimand Tract claim opened Monday. Phase 1 decides Crown liability; compensation sought, not seizure of private land.

item.title: Viral: Egyptian balcony rescue CCTV confirmed
item.description: Confirmed: Ahmed Ragab caught a child falling from a Giza balcony; Al Jazeera, Khaleej Times, Gulf News. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lnfuQAjQmmo

item.title: Viral claim check: Alberta mail-in ballots open to anyone — False
item.description: False: Elections Alberta manually reviews applications; out-of-province packages are declined. CP/Global fact check.

item.title: Viral claim check: Elon Musk water-shortage deaths video — False / deepfake
item.description: False: Full Fact found the circulating Musk water-shortage warning video is a deepfake.

item.title: Science: Brain implant decodes speech and gestures for mind-controlled avatar
item.description: UCSF ECoG study in Nature Neuroscience simultaneously decodes speech and gestures for a virtual avatar. Early-stage research.
